title: Chapter 38 — Dusk
paragraphs: By the mainmast. Starbuck leaning against it.

My soul is more than matched — she's overpowered, and by a madman! What an unbearable sting, that sanity should lay down its arms on such a battlefield! But he drilled deep down and blasted all my reason out of me! I think I see his impious end, but I feel that I must help him reach it. Whether I will or not, the unspeakable thing has tied me to him, towing me with a cable I have no knife to cut. Horrible old man! "Who's above me?" he cries — yes, he would be a democrat to all above, but look how he lords it over all below! Oh! I can plainly see my miserable duty: to obey while rebelling, and worse still, to hate with a touch of pity! For in his eyes I read some terrible grief that would shrivel me up if I had it. Yet there is still hope. Time and tide flow wide. The hated whale has the whole round watery world to swim in, as a small goldfish has its glass globe. His heaven-insulting purpose — God may push it aside. I would take heart, if my heart were not like lead. But my whole clock has run down. My heart is the weight that controls everything, and I have no key to wind it again.
(A burst of revelry from the forecastle.)

Oh, God! To sail with such a heathen crew that have so little of human mothers in them! Whelped somewhere by the shark-infested sea. The white whale is their demon god. Listen! Those infernal celebrations! That revelry is forward. Notice the unbroken silence aft! It seems to me a picture of life. The bow shoots forward, gay and combative, through the sparkling sea — but only to drag dark Ahab after it, where he broods inside his cabin at the stern, built over the dead water of the wake, and further on, haunted by its wolfish gurgling. The long howl thrills me through! Quiet, you revelers, and set the watch! Oh, life! It is in an hour like this, with the soul beaten down and forced to face knowledge — as wild, untamed creatures are forced to feed — oh, life! It is now that I feel the hidden horror in you! But it is not in me! That horror is outside of me! And with the soft human feeling still in me, I will try to fight you, grim phantom futures! Stand by me, hold me, bind me, O you blessed influences!
